_comment: One LPDDR6 channel (2 subchannels x 2 ranks), the LP6 of the Part 3 results. Run builds with runtime/decode.py --lp6-config configs/LPDDR6_PIM_Mobile_2CH.ini (docs/history/README.md: the former Part 3 settings). Target description read by hyb-partition, hyb-npu-tile, hyb-npu-memplan and the NPU backend. NPU values followed the former Part 3 settings (docs/history/README.md); PIM values follow dram-pim configs/LPDDR6_PIM_Mobile_2CH.ini. pim.efficiency and npu.lp6_read_gbps are fitted to simulator runs of this compiler (runtime/calibrate.py on Qwen3-4B 1 layer, hybrid vs NPU-only; efficiency 2026-09-26, lp6_read_gbps 2026-09-29 with address_mapping rarobacobgch); the boundary costs (act_write_*, readback_*) and gemv_fixed_us are estimates from the former hybrid_bench (docs/history RESULTS 19.1), not fitted. None of these values is from the LPDDR6-PIM PDF. pim.concurrent_ranks remains false to preserve the existing calibration and baseline; it is not required by an absence of cross-rank PIM timing. Draft 13.6 maps PIMX to base Meta commands, whose cross-rank 2 CK in the supported WCK-always-on/ODT-off profile is enforced by the shared CA scheduler. true permits both ranks to compute while sharing external DQ. See lp6-pim-main docs/research/20261006/RANK_OVERLAP_SPEC_REVIEW.md and TWO_RANK_PIM_BASELINE.md for validation and remaining protocol/input-feed limits.
